native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55
native.note: Onset is 255.875 red/PRESENT. Restore to ABSENT at 265.250 is not onset. The first non-elevated failure is not onset.

finshield.method: panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 plus full-frame minus taskbar
finshield.note: Panel stayed ABSENT. netsh command-not-found, classifier text, and dangerouslyDisableSandbox are not the desktop measurement.
